hypotheses.expect: store.process_start answers the creation time of a RUNNING pid on Windows (GetProcessTimes), None for a pid that is gone, so minter_alive is True for a live process and sweep_scratch never drops the live scratch tables of the process that calls it.
hypotheses.falsifier: (1) process_start of a running child is its creation time (within a minute of now) and minter_alive is True for this process and for the child; (2) process_start of a pid that has exited is None and minter_alive is False for it; (3) sweep_scratch() leaves this process's own live scratch table standing and registered
hypotheses.piece: D1: the Windows branch of process_start.
